emotional_direction.central_tension: The veteran sailing warship is magnificent but powerless, towed by a tiny steam tug toward dismantling; Turner deliberately changes reality to give it a dignified farewell.

evidence_details.location: left half, tall pale three-masted Temeraire
evidence_details.observation: The pale old warship is shown with masts and rigging that were already removed before its actual tow.
evidence_details.significance: Turner restores its dignity as a ghostly historical presence; the masts are a documented poetic alteration.

evidence_details.location: lower left-center, squat dark tug ahead of the Temeraire
evidence_details.observation: A small paddle-wheel steam tug tows the enormous pale warship and bears a dark funnel.
evidence_details.significance: A visual collision of old naval glory and new industrial propulsion, not proof of Turner's simple hostility to steam.

evidence_details.location: middle left, warm dark plume behind tug funnel
evidence_details.observation: The tug's funnel and smoke are deliberately arranged so the plume sweeps back toward the old masts.
evidence_details.significance: The smoke visually binds the two ships and heightens the sense of historical transition.

evidence_details.location: right third, white-gold sun under crimson-orange clouds
evidence_details.observation: A luminous setting sun fills the right-hand sky; the sunset is placed in a geographically impossible direction for the voyage.
evidence_details.significance: The poetic sunset communicates farewell rather than a literal record of the Thames tow.

evidence_details.location: upper left above the Temeraire, pale crescent moon
evidence_details.observation: A faint crescent moon appears over the old ship while the sun glows on the opposite side.
evidence_details.significance: Its juxtaposition with the sunset supports an interpretation of ending and beginning, not a fixed secret code.

evidence_details.location: lower right foreground, near-black buoy on the water
evidence_details.observation: A dark buoy punctuates the water opposite the tug and balances the wide bright sky.
evidence_details.significance: It anchors the composition and makes the quiet river feel deep and expansive.

emotional_direction.opening_hook: A glowing, ghostlike ship seems heroic; by seven seconds the small dark tug reveals it cannot move on its own.
emotional_direction.closing_payoff: The whole picture is revisited as a poetic farewell, not as a literal reconstruction of the Thames journey.
emotional_direction.wow_justification: The apparent power hierarchy flips when the tiny tug is revealed pulling the immense warship; viewers discover Turner's purposeful historical distortions.

critico_standard.variation_reason: The authentic details alone carry the nuanced critical narration, with no gallery reconstruction.
